title: AS2 compiler: silent fallback opcodes should throw at compile time
description: In compiler.ts, the default case in compileAssignValueOp emits 0x47 (Add2) for unrecognized compound-assignment operators, and compileBinaryExpr's default silently pushes undefined. Both should throw a compile-time error instead of producing wrong runtime behavior. Audit which operators reach the default and add the throw/warning.
